items.title: Breaking: Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam Generates Full Power
items.description: The GERD has officially begun full power generation, marking a historic milestone for Ethiopia's development and energy independence. The dam's turbines are now operating at full capacity, providing reliable electricity to millions of households and businesses across the nation.
items.summary: GERD achieves full power generation capacity, transforming Ethiopia's energy landscape.
items.author: Solomon Tesfaye

items.title: Ethiopian Athletes Sweep Tokyo Marathon
items.description: Ethiopian runners have claimed all top three positions in both men's and women's categories at the Tokyo International Marathon. The victory showcases the continued dominance of Ethiopian long-distance runners on the global stage.
items.author: Lemlem Haile

items.title: New Economic Reform Package Announced
items.description: Prime Minister's office unveils comprehensive economic reform package aimed at attracting foreign investment and boosting local industries. The package includes tax incentives for manufacturers and streamlined business registration processes.
items.author: Betelhem Abate

items.title: Timket Festival Draws Millions to Gondar
items.description: The annual Ethiopian Orthodox Epiphany celebration, Timket, has attracted over 2 million pilgrims to Gondar. The festival, recognized by UNESCO, showcases Ethiopia's rich cultural and religious heritage.
items.author: Meron Assefa

items.title: Ethiopian Airlines Launches Direct Flights to Chicago
items.description: Ethiopian Airlines, Africa's largest carrier, has launched thrice-weekly direct flights from Addis Ababa to Chicago O'Hare. The new route strengthens Ethiopia's connectivity with North America.
items.author: Dawit Mekonnen

items.title: Breakthrough in Coffee Export: Ethiopia Signs Deal with Starbucks
items.description: Ethiopia has signed a historic $500 million coffee export agreement with Starbucks, securing premium prices for Ethiopian farmers and expanding market access for the country's renowned coffee varieties.
items.author: Tigist Hailemariam

items.title: New Space Observatory Opens in Entoto
items.description: Ethiopia's first space observatory has officially opened on Mount Entoto, positioning the country as a emerging player in African space research and astronomy.
items.author: Yonas Desta
